notablePrerequisites: Any other noncreature spell in hand with the mana to cast it.
description:
Cast the noncreature spell.
Blood Funnel triggers; decline to sacrifice a creature and let the spell be countered.
Guile replaces Blood Funnel's countering of the spell; exile the spell and cast it for free again.
Blood Funnel triggers again; repeat this loop for infinite storm count.
